name: io.github.Servosity/watchguard-mcp
title: WatchGuard MCP
description: WatchGuard Cloud Firebox, Endpoint Security, ThreatSync, NDR and AuthPoint APIs for every customer

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: WatchGuard Cloud API Access ID (read-write or read-only).

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your WatchGuard Cloud account ID (ACC-... or WGC-...).

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: region API base URL; default https://api.usa.cloud.watchguard.com (EMEA api.deu, APAC api.jpn).

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: region OAuth token URL; default https://api.usa.cloud.watchguard.com/oauth/token.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: a managed account's audience value; requests use that customer's token (not a security boundary).

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: OAuth scope to request; default api-access.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the User-Agent the CLI sends.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 to run the MCP server read-only.

environmentVariables.name: WATCHGUARD_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by the stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not enforced by this connector (no tenant-gated profiles); leave unset. It does not limit which accounts a call can reach.
